The '''''Nal Hutta Kal'tamok''''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] run newsnet service which covered the politics and economy of buying, selling and transporting goods. It was widely used by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. Nevertheless, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities tolerated its existence, primarily because many influential officials used it for their own purposes. [[S. Moshuddaa]] was a reporter for this paper.
